searchType.title: Search type
searchType.description: What to pull from the FEC: candidates, committees, itemized individual contributions, or independent expenditures.

query.title: Search text
query.description: Name to search. For candidates and committees this is the q filter; for contributions it matches contributor_name; for expenditures it matches payee_name. Empty returns all (combined with other filters).

committeeId.title: Committee ID
committeeId.description: Optional FEC committee ID (e.g. C00401224). Required for contribution and expenditure pulls to stay fast; contributions/expenditures without it can time out on the FEC side.

candidateId.title: Candidate ID
candidateId.description: Optional FEC candidate ID (e.g. H6TX34072) for expenditure pulls.

office.title: Office (candidate search)
office.description: Optional office filter for candidate search.

party.title: Party
party.description: Optional party filter for candidates/committees (e.g. DEM, REP).

twoYearPeriod.title: FEC two-year transaction period
twoYearPeriod.description: FEC cycle year for money queries. Defaults to 2026 (the current cycle).

maxItems.title: Max result rows
maxItems.description: Hard cap on rows pushed. The run stops as soon as the cap is hit so you never pay for results you didn't ask for.

apiKey.title: FEC API key (optional)
apiKey.description: OpenFEC API key. DEMO_KEY works for light tests but is shared and rate limited; get a free key in one minute at https://api.data.gov/signup/ and paste it here for reliable volume.
